      var monthEnd   = new Date(year, month+1, 0);
      var evStart    = new Date(ev.startDate.getFullYear(), ev.startDate.getMonth(), ev.startDate.getDate());
      var evEnd      = new Date(ev.endDate.getFullYear(),   ev.endDate.getMonth(),   ev.endDate.getDate());
      return evStart <= monthEnd && evEnd >= monthStart;
    });
  }

      if (mobSelectedDate) {
        openMobileFeed(mobSelectedDate); // refresh feed with updated filters
      } else {
        renderMobileGrid();
      }
    }
  }

  /* ====== MOBILE HYBRID CALENDAR ====== */
  function mobBuildCell(dayNum, date, isToday, isSelected) {
    var cell = document.createElement('div');
    var cls  = 'mob-cell';
    if (!date)      cls += ' mob-cell--empty';
    if (isToday)    cls += ' mob-cell--today';
    if (isSelected) cls += ' mob-cell--selected';
    cell.className = cls;
    if (date) {
      var num = document.createElement('div');
      num.className  = 'mob-num';
      num.textContent = dayNum;
      cell.appendChild(num);
      var evs = getEventsForDay(date, getFilteredEvents());
      if (evs.length > 0) {
        var dots = document.createElement('div');
        dots.className = 'mob-dots';
        var seen = {};
        evs.forEach(function(ev) {
          if (!seen[ev.type]) {
            seen[ev.type] = true;
            var dot = document.createElement('div');
            dot.className = 'mob-dot mob-dot--' + ev.type;
            dots.appendChild(dot);
          }
        });
        cell.appendChild(dots);
      }
      cell.setAttribute('data-ts', date.getTime());
    }
    return cell;
  }

  function renderMobileGrid() {
    var container = document.getElementById('mobFullGrid');
    if (!container) return;
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.style.display = 'block';
    container.classList.remove('collapsing');

    var strip = document.getElementById('mobWeekStrip');
    var feed  = document.getElementById('mobDayFeed');
    if (strip) { strip.style.display = 'none'; strip.className = 'mob-week-strip'; }
    if (feed)  { feed.className = 'mob-day-feed'; }

    var grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'mob-grid';
    MOB_DAYS_SHORT.forEach(function(d) {
      var h = document.createElement('div');
      h.className  = 'mob-hdr';
      h.textContent = d;
      grid.appendChild(h);
    });

    var firstDay    = new Date(curYear, curMonth, 1).getDay();
    var daysInMonth = new Date(curYear, curMonth+1, 0).getDate();
    for (var i = 0; i < firstDay; i++) {
      grid.appendChild(mobBuildCell(0, null, false, false));
    }
    for (var d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
      var date    = new Date(curYear, curMonth, d);
      var isT     = sameDay(date, today);
      var isSel   = !!(mobSelectedDate && sameDay(date, mobSelectedDate));
      grid.appendChild(mobBuildCell(d, date, isT, isSel));
    }
    container.appendChild(grid);

    grid.querySelectorAll('.mob-cell[data-ts]').forEach(function(cell) {
      cell.addEventListener('click', function() {
        onMobileDayTap(new Date(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-ts'))));
      });
    });
  }

  function onMobileDayTap(date) {
    mobSelectedDate = date;
    var fullGrid = document.getElementById('mobFullGrid');
    if (fullGrid) fullGrid.classList.add('collapsing');
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (fullGrid) fullGrid.style.display = 'none';
      renderMobileWeekStrip(date);
      openMobileFeed(date);
    }, 200);
  }

  function renderMobileWeekStrip(selDate) {
    var strip = document.getElementById('mobWeekStrip');
    if (!strip) return;
    strip.innerHTML    = '';
    strip.style.display    = 'block';
    strip.style.opacity    = '0';
    strip.style.transform  = 'translateY(-6px)';
    strip.style.transition = '';

    var firstDay    = new Date(curYear, curMonth, 1).getDay();
    var daysInMonth = new Date(curYear, curMonth+1, 0).getDate();
    var cellIndex   = firstDay + selDate.getDate() - 1;
    var weekStart   = Math.floor(cellIndex / 7) * 7;

    var hdrRow = document.createElement('div');
    hdrRow.className = 'mob-week-row';
    MOB_DAYS_SHORT.forEach(function(d) {
      var h = document.createElement('div');
      h.className  = 'mob-hdr';
      h.textContent = d;
      hdrRow.appendChild(h);
    });
    strip.appendChild(hdrRow);

    var weekRow = document.createElement('div');
    weekRow.className = 'mob-week-row';
    for (var col = 0; col < 7; col++) {
      var dayNum = weekStart + col - firstDay + 1;
      var date   = (dayNum >= 1 && dayNum <= daysInMonth) ? new Date(curYear, curMonth, dayNum) : null;
      weekRow.appendChild(mobBuildCell(date ? dayNum : 0, date, date ? sameDay(date, today) : false, date ? sameDay(date, selDate) : false));
    }
    strip.appendChild(weekRow);

    // Slide in
    requestAnimationFrame(function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        strip.style.transition = 'opacity 0.22s ease, transform 0.22s ease';
        strip.style.opacity    = '1';
        strip.style.transform  = 'translateY(0)';
      });
    });

    // Tap a different day in the week strip
    weekRow.querySelectorAll('.mob-cell[data-ts]').forEach(function(cell) {
      cell.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var d = new Date(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-ts')));
        mobSelectedDate = d;
        weekRow.querySelectorAll('.mob-cell').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove('mob-cell--selected'); });
        this.classList.add('mob-cell--selected');
        openMobileFeed(d);
      });
    });
  }

  function openMobileFeed(date) {
    var feed = document.getElementById('mobDayFeed');
    if (!feed) return;

    var filtered = getFilteredEvents();
    var dayEvs   = getEventsForDay(date, filtered);
    var dayLabel  = date.getDate() + ' ב' + HEB_MONTHS[date.getMonth()];

    var listHtml = '';
    if (dayEvs.length === 0) {
      listHtml = '<div class="mob-feed-empty">אין אירועים ביום זה 🏖</div>';
    } else {
      dayEvs.forEach(function(ev) {
        var dateStr = sameDay(ev.startDate, ev.endDate)
          ? formatDate(ev.startDate)
          : formatDateShort(ev.startDate) + ' – ' + formatDateShort(ev.endDate);
        listHtml +=
          '<div class="mob-ev-card mob-ev-card--' + ev.type + '" data-ev-id="' + ev.id + '">' +
            '<div class="mob-ev-icon">' + flagImg(ev.country, 22) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="mob-ev-body">' +
              '<div class="mob-ev-title">' + ev.title + '</div>' +
              '<div class="mob-ev-meta">' + dateStr + ' · ' + ev.city + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="mob-ev-arr">‹</div>' +
          '</div>';
      });
    }

    feed.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mob-feed-header">' +
        '<div class="mob-feed-title">📅 ' + dayLabel + '</div>' +
        '<button class="mob-feed-back" id="mobFeedBack">↑ כל החודש</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="mob-feed-list">' + listHtml + '</div>';

    feed.querySelectorAll('.mob-ev-card[data-ev-id]').forEach(function(card) {
      var evId = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-ev-id'));
      var ev;
      for (var i = 0; i < EVENTS.length; i++) { if (EVENTS[i].id === evId) { ev = EVENTS[i]; break; } }
      if (ev) card.addEventListener('click', function() { openModal(ev); });
    });
    document.getElementById('mobFeedBack').addEventListener('click', expandMobileToFull);

    feed.className = 'mob-day-feed open';

    // Swipe down to dismiss
    feed._swipeY = 0;
    feed.ontouchstart = function(e) { feed._swipeY = e.touches[0].clientY; };
    feed.ontouchend   = function(e) {
      if ((e.changedTouches[0].clientY - feed._swipeY) > 70 && feed.scrollTop === 0) {
        expandMobileToFull();
      }
    };
  }

  function expandMobileToFull() {
    mobSelectedDate = null;
    var feed     = document.getElementById('mobDayFeed');
    var strip    = document.getElementById('mobWeekStrip');
    var fullGrid = document.getElementById('mobFullGrid');

    if (feed)  feed.className = 'mob-day-feed';
    if (strip) {
      strip.style.transition = 'opacity 0.22s ease, transform 0.22s ease';
      strip.style.opacity    = '0';
      strip.style.transform  = 'translateY(-6px)';
      setTimeout(function() { if (strip) strip.style.display = 'none'; }, 220);
    }
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (fullGrid) {
        fullGrid.classList.remove('collapsing');
        fullGrid.style.display = 'block';
      }
      renderMobileGrid();
    }, 220);
  }

  /* ====== MODAL ====== */
  function openModal(ev) {
    var backdrop = document.getElementById('modalBackdrop');
    var body     = document.getElementById('modalBody');

    var dateStr;
    if (sameDay(ev.startDate, ev.endDate)) {
      dateStr = formatDate(ev.startDate);
    } else {
      dateStr = formatDate(ev.startDate) + ' – ' + formatDate(ev.endDate);
    }

    // Google Calendar URL
    var gcEnd = ev.endDate;
    var gcUrl = 'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE' +
      '&text=' + encodeURIComponent(ev.title) +
      '&dates=' + gcalDate(ev.startDate) + '/' + gcalEndDate(ev.endDate) +
      '&details=' + encodeURIComponent(ev.description) +
      '&location=' + encodeURIComponent(ev.city);

    // WhatsApp share
    var waText = '🗓️ ' + ev.title + '\n📍 ' + ev.city + '\n📅 ' + dateStr + '\n\n' + ev.description + '\n\nדרך מתי טסים: https://www.mataytasim.co.il/calendar.html';
    var waUrl  = 'https://wa.me/?text=' + encodeURIComponent(waText);

    // Stores box color
    var storesHtml = '';
    if (ev.stores) {
      var isRed = ev.stores.indexOf('🔴') !== -1;
      storesHtml = '<div class="modal__stores-box modal__stores-box--' + (isRed ? 'red' : 'yellow') + '">' + ev.stores + '</div>';
    }

    body.innerHTML =
      '<h2 class="modal__flag-title" id="modalTitle">' + flagImg(ev.country, 24) + ' ' + ev.title + '</h2>' +
      '<div class="modal__badges">' +
        '<span class="modal__badge badge--' + ev.type + '">' + TYPE_LABELS[ev.type] + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="modal__meta">' +
        '<div class="modal__meta-row">📅 ' + dateStr + '</div>' +
        '<div class="modal__meta-row">📍 ' + ev.city + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      storesHtml +
      '<p class="modal__desc">' + ev.description + '</p>' +
      '<div class="modal__tip"><strong>💡 טיפ של מתי טסים:</strong>' + ev.tip + '</div>' +
      '<div class="modal__actions">' +
        '<a href="' + gcUrl + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="modal__action-btn modal__action-btn--primary">📅 הוסף ליומן Google</a>' +
        '<a href="' + waUrl + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="modal__action-btn modal__action-btn--wa">📲 שתף בוואטסאפ</a>' +
      '</div>';

    backdrop.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    document.getElementById('modalCloseBtn').focus();
  }

  function closeModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  /* ====== VIEW TOGGLE ====== */
  function setView(isList) {
    isListView = isList;
    var calWrap = document.getElementById('calendarGridWrap');
    var listEl  = document.getElementById('listView');
    var calBtn  = document.getElementById('viewCalendar');
    var listBtn = document.getElementById('viewList');

    if (isList) {
      calWrap.classList.add('hidden');
      calWrap.classList.remove('active', 'show-mobile');
      listEl.classList.add('active');
      calBtn.classList.remove('active');
      calBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
      listBtn.classList.add('active');
      listBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
    } else {
      calWrap.classList.remove('hidden');
      calWrap.classList.add('active', 'show-mobile');
      listEl.classList.remove('active');
      calBtn.classList.add('active');
      calBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
      listBtn.classList.remove('active');
      listBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
    }
  }

  /* ====== MONTH NAVIGATION ====== */
  function goToMonth(delta) {
    curMonth += delta;
    if (curMonth > 11) { curMonth = 0; curYear++; }
    if (curMonth < 0)  { curMonth = 11; curYear--; }
    mobSelectedDate = null;
    renderAll();
  }

  function fetchMenuWeather() {
    var el = (document.getElementById("__legacy_menuWeatherSnippet") || document.createElement("span"));
    if (!el) return;
    weatherCityIndex = (weatherCityIndex + 1) % WEATHER_CITIES.length;
    var city = WEATHER_CITIES[weatherCityIndex];
    el.textContent = city.name + '...';
    fetch('https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=' + city.lat + '&longitude=' + city.lon + '&current_weather=true')
      .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function(d) {
        var t    = Math.round(d.current_weather.temperature);
        var code = d.current_weather.weathercode;
        var icon = code <= 1 ? '☀️' : code <= 3 ? '⛅' : code <= 67 ? '🌧' : '❄️';
        el.textContent = city.name + ' עכשיו ' + t + '°C ' + icon;
      })
      .catch(function() { el.textContent = 'מזג אוויר באירופה'; });
  }

  (document.getElementById("__legacy_hamburgerBtn") || document.createElement("button")).addEventListener('click', function() {
    var menu     = (document.getElementById("__legacy_mobileMenu") || document.createElement("div"));

    this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded));
    this.setAttribute('aria-label', expanded ? 'פתח תפריט' : 'סגור תפריט');

  // Month nav buttons
  document.getElementById('prevMonthBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){ goToMonth(-1); });
  document.getElementById('nextMonthBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){ goToMonth(1); });
  document.getElementById('backToTodayBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    curMonth = todayMonth;
    curYear  = todayYear;
    renderAll();
  });

  // View toggle
  document.getElementById('viewCalendar').addEventListener('click', function(){ setView(false); });
  document.getElementById('viewList').addEventListener('click', function(){ setView(true); });

  // Country filter
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-country]').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var c = this.getAttribute('data-country');
      activeCountry = c;
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-country]').forEach(function(b) {
        var isActive = b.getAttribute('data-country') === c;
        b.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(isActive));
      });
      renderAll();
    });
  });

  // Type filter (multi-select toggle)
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-type]').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var t = this.getAttribute('data-type');
      activeTypes[t] = !activeTypes[t];
      this.classList.toggle('active', activeTypes[t]);
      this.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(activeTypes[t]));
      renderAll();
    });
  });

  // Modal close
  document.getElementById('modalCloseBtn').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) closeModal();
  });

  // Keyboard nav
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    var backdrop = document.getElementById('modalBackdrop');
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && backdrop.classList.contains('open')) {
      closeModal();
      return;
    }
    if (backdrop.classList.contains('open')) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') goToMonth(-1);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  goToMonth(1);
  });

  function handleResize() {
    if (window.innerWidth < 768 && !isListView) {
      // only auto-switch if user hasn't manually toggled
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize, { passive: true });

  /* ====== INIT ====== */
  if (!isMobile) {
    setView(false);
  }
  renderAll();
  if (isMobile) {
    // Month/Year title tap → return to full grid
    var monthTitleEl = document.getElementById('monthTitle');
    if (monthTitleEl) {
      monthTitleEl.addEventListener('click', expandMobileToFull);
    }
  }
